description: This file defines a widget called AppProviders that sets up dependency injection for the application using the provider package. It primarily manages a RecipesProvider instance and makes it available to the widget subtree.

classes.name: AppProviders
classes.description: A stateless widget that provides multiple providers (specifically RecipesProvider) to its child widget tree.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, wrapping the child widget with a MultiProvider that supplies the RecipesProvider.
